sections.section: RULE - Loans for Agricultural Purposes Rules 1973
sections.description:
LOANS FOR AGRICULTURAL PURPOSES
LOANS
FOR AGRICULTURAL PURPOSES
RULES, 1973
(Amendment
of R.5 and Sched.1)
[Gazette
of Pakistan, Extraordinary Part II,
12th November, 2010]
S.R.O. 126(KE)/2010, dated
12-7-2010.---In exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Loans for
Agricultural Purposes Act, 1973 (XLII of 1973), the Federal Government is
pleased to direct that the following further amendments shall be made in the
Loans for Agricultural Purposes Rules, 1973, namely;--
In the aforesaid Rules:
(a) in rule 5, in sub-rule (2) for the
words twelve hundred the words two thousand shall be substituted; and
(b) in Schedule 1, in form 2, in Colomn
14, for the figure 1200 the figure 2000 shall be substituted.
